metadata.description: Open-source, governed legal workflow plugin maintained by l0cka.

plugins.name: legal-skills
plugins.description: Governed legal workflows, mostly Australian: research, contracts, drafting, employment, work health and safety, privacy, consumer and competition, corporations, AI governance, AML/CTF, estates, litigation deadlines, evidence, matter triage and jurisdiction-neutral reasoning practice, with official-source verification and qualified-lawyer review gates.
